result.reason: The clause properly covers Affiliates and contractors, but it does not itself establish that paid-up licences are perpetual and irrevocable or that subscription licences are terminable only for uncured material breach; those protections depend on unseen Sections 13.2 and 13.3 and cannot be supplied by the margin comment. It also goes beyond the playbook by permitting transfers to Affiliates and adding a suspension restriction. The drafting is generally professional, but the critical protections should be stated expressly or incorporated through a verifiably precise cross-reference.
